summary: iter437 Settlements Module verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/vehicles/dealer/pending-settlements returns 4 seeded settlements (auth-gated: 403 without token). Frontend renders 3-module dashboard in correct order (My Vehicles → Sales & Performance → Settlements). Summary values pending=$57,500 and paid=$33,000 match spec exactly. All 4 rows have correct sale price / buyer premium (2.5%) / seller commission ($0) / net payout. Status pills map correctly: AWAITING_DEALER_CONFIRMATION→pending, DEALER_CONFIRMED→processing, FULLY_SETTLED→paid. Mobile viewport hides desktop table (.md:block) and shows mobile card list (.md:hidden). Fee-model footnote text matches spec verbatim. Navbar regression (no 'Vehicle Dashboard' link) confirmed. /vehicle-auctions/my-listings redirects to /vehicle-dashboard. No React Error #31 crashes.

issues: 'Annual Platform Fee Required' orange banner is a full-width fixed strip that overlaps the top navbar language toggle at 1920x1080 — clicking [data-testid=language-fr-btn] with force=true navigated to Stripe /pay (likely a Pay-Now anchor beneath the toggle). Not a settlements-module bug, but blocks testability of the FR language switch.

action_items: FR bilingual runtime verification is inconclusive: on cold load with localStorage i18nextLng='fr', the app still rendered EN labels (heading 'Vehicle Dashboard' + '$57,500' Intl EN format), meaning user preferred_language='fr' is NOT applied on login. Code review confirms the SettlementsModule uses t('settlements.*') keys correctly and en.json/fr.json blocks exist per PRD — issue is broader i18n bootstrap, not settlements-scoped. Main agent should verify the i18n init reads user.preferred_language on login/refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: SettlementsModule.jsx computes summary correctly: 'disputed' bucket rows are EXCLUDED from both pending and paid totals — acceptable but worth documenting so a disputed settlement doesn't silently disappear from summaries.

Row keys use `r.auction_id` — if a dealer ever has two settlements on the same auction (edge case), the React key collision could cause a render warning. Consider `${auction_id}-${settlement_id}` if that's possible in schema.

Both desktop table AND mobile card list render simultaneously in DOM (only CSS-hidden). Same `settlement-row-{id}` testid appears twice — playwright .count() returns 2× actual rows. Consider suffixing with `-desktop`/`-mobile` for cleaner testability (but PRD explicitly said keep same testid pattern, so acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all DOM/data assertions pass; FR runtime switch not verified due to i18n bootstrap issue outside settlements scope)
